sn52.8:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiyaṃ viharati salalāgāre.
sn52.8:1.3: seyyathāpi āvuso, gaṅgānadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā.
sn52.8:1.5: “mayaṃ imaṃ gaṅgānadiṃ pacchāninnaṃ karissāma pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāranti.
sn52.8:1.6: taṃ kiṃ maññathāvuso, api nu so mahājanakāyo gaṅgānadiṃ pacchāninnaṃ kareyya pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāranti.
sn52.8:1.10: sā na sukarā pacchāninnaṃ kātuṃ pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāraṃ.
sn52.8:1.11: yāvadeva ca pana so mahājanakāyo kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti.
sn52.8:2.1: evameva kho āvuso, bhikkhuṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāventaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bahulīkarontaṃ rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātisālohitā vā bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ:
sn52.8:2.2: “hambho purisa, kiṃ te ime kāsāvā anudahanti.
sn52.8:2.4: ehi hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge bhuñjassu puññāni ca karohī”ti.
sn52.8:3.1: so vatāvuso bhikkhu cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāvento cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bahulīkaronto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāyahīnāyāvattissatīti, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn52.8:3.3: “yaṃ hi āvuso cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ vivekaninnaṃ vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ. taṃ tathā hīnāyāvattissatī”ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn52.8:3.4: kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāveti, cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bahulīkaroti:
sn52.8:3.5: idhāvuso, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.8:3.8: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.8:3.9: evaṃ kho āvuso, bhikkhu cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāveti, cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bahulīkarotīti.
